promptSet.description:
Prompt 1:
Ultra-realistic professional studio portrait of a confident young man sitting on a bright yellow geometric cube, centered composition, legs slightly apart, hands resting naturally between knees, direct eye contact with camera, clean white luxury tracksuit (crewneck sweatshirt and joggers), pristine white sneakers, deep matte red seamless studio backdrop and floor, high-end fashion campaign aesthetic, minimalistic color blocking, bold contrast between red background, white outfit, and yellow cube.
Shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens, f/2.8, razor-sharp facial details, natural skin texture, realistic fabric folds, soft cinematic studio lighting, subtle shadow falloff, premium editorial photography, luxury streetwear advertisement, symmetrical framing, ultra-clean background, magazine-quality retouching, photorealistic, HDR, 8K, extremely detailed, realistic proportions, natural pose, no text, no watermark, no logo.

Negative Prompt:
cartoon, illustration, CGI, 3D render, AI look, overprocessed skin, extra fingers, extra limbs, distorted hands, bad anatomy, blurry face, low resolution, grainy image, harsh shadows, oversaturated colors, floating objects, duplicate body parts, messy background, text, watermark, logo, cropped feet, wide-angle distortion, unrealistic clothing folds, plastic skin, uncanny valley, exaggerated muscles.

For a stronger Instagram-style result:
Add:
luxury fashion campaign for a global sportswear brand, trending on Pinterest, studio photography by Annie Leibovitz, Vogue editorial quality, perfectly balanced color palette, premium commercial advertising shot, viral visual aesthetic, award-winning photography, hyper-realistic details, professional retouching, clean luxury branding look. ratio 4:5


Prompt 2:
Ultra-realistic cinematic neon portrait of a confident young man with curly textured hair, round metal-frame glasses, well-groomed beard, wearing a black turtleneck and premium black leather jacket, posing in a three-quarter side profile while looking directly toward the camera with a calm dominant expression.
Dramatic dual-color studio lighting with intense electric blue light from the left side and vibrant magenta-pink light from the right side, creating rich color separation across the face, glasses, hair, and jacket. Smooth seamless blue-to-magenta gradient background with soft atmospheric glow. Luxury cyber-fashion editorial aesthetic, premium commercial photography, highly detailed skin texture, realistic facial pores, sharp eyes, subtle reflections on eyeglass lenses, glossy leather material rendering, cinematic contrast, shallow depth of field.
Shot on Sony A7R V, 85mm f/1.4 lens, professional studio setup, Vogue-quality fashion campaign, luxury eyewear advertisement, dramatic mood, ultra-clean composition, hyper-realistic, photorealistic, HDR, 8K, award-winning portrait photography, perfect facial symmetry, crisp focus, premium color grading.

Negative Prompt:
cartoon, anime, CGI, 3D render, illustration, AI artifacts, low resolution, blurry face, distorted glasses, extra fingers, bad anatomy, plastic skin, oversaturated colors, washed-out lighting, double face, asymmetrical eyes, poorly rendered beard, text, logo, watermark, grain, noise, low detail, unrealistic reflections, overexposed highlights, distorted proportions, duplicate features.

To make it even closer to this exact style, append:
moody cyberpunk portrait, blue and pink neon split lighting, luxury eyewear campaign, dark fashion editorial, reflective leather jacket, clean gradient backdrop, Gen Z luxury aesthetic, studio portrait photography, dramatic side angle composition, premium Instagram portrait, striking color contrast, modern creative director photoshoot, ultra-realistic skin texture. ratio 4:5


Prompt 3:
Create a hyper-realistic executive studio portrait using the uploaded person's face and identity. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, facial structure, body proportions, and identity with maximum accuracy.
The subject stands confidently with arms crossed, facing the camera directly. Expression is calm, self-assured, intelligent, and trustworthy, projecting the presence of a successful founder, consultant, or industry leader. Strong posture, shoulders back, natural confidence, and direct eye contact.
Wearing a fitted premium black t-shirt that enhances a clean, modern, minimalist aesthetic. Thin round metal-frame eyeglasses and a luxury stainless-steel wristwatch complete the look.
The background is a deep black-to-navy gradient with a subtle electric-blue halo glow behind the subject, creating dramatic separation and a premium corporate branding feel. No distractions, props, text, or unnecessary elements.
Professional studio lighting with a large soft key light positioned slightly above eye level, creating realistic facial contours, sharp jawline definition, natural skin texture, and subtle catchlights in the eyes. Gentle rim lighting on the shoulders and hair provides cinematic depth while maintaining realism.
Composition: Vertical portrait, mid-thigh to chest framing, centered composition, symmetrical balance, direct eye contact, arms crossed confidently.
Photography Style: Fortune 500 executive portrait, premium LinkedIn profile photo, luxury personal branding photoshoot, high-end corporate campaign, Apple keynote speaker aesthetic, ultra-photorealistic, 85mm lens, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, HDR, cinematic lighting, realistic skin pores, detailed hair texture, commercial photography, 8K.
Important: Keep the uploaded person's face 100% recognizable. Do not alter facial structure, age, hairstyle, skin tone, body shape, or identity. Avoid AI-generated artifacts, plastic skin, excessive sharpening, unrealistic muscles, distorted arms, extra fingers, warped glasses, or fake-looking lighting. The image should look indistinguishable from a real professional studio portrait captured by a world-class commercial photographer.


Prompt 4:
Create a hyper-realistic professional creator/designer portrait using the uploaded person's face and identity. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, facial structure, smile, and identity with maximum facial accuracy.
The subject is standing in a relaxed three-quarter pose, slightly turned toward the camera while smiling naturally as if caught during a productive creative moment. Holding a premium tablet in one hand and a digital stylus in the other, appearing to be reviewing designs, taking notes, or sketching ideas.
Wearing a fitted dark charcoal premium crew-neck t-shirt and minimalist transparent-frame eyeglasses. The styling should feel modern, intelligent, approachable, and highly professional.
The background is a seamless soft grey studio backdrop with a clean, minimalist aesthetic. No distractions, no props, no text. Pure focus on the subject.
Studio lighting is soft and flattering with a large diffused key light creating natural skin tones, realistic catchlights, and subtle facial contours. Gentle rim lighting separates the subject from the background while maintaining a premium editorial look.
Expression should feel authentic and candid, as if the subject just received good news or is genuinely enjoying their work. Natural laugh lines, realistic teeth, and believable facial emotion.
Composition: Vertical portrait, waist-up framing, slight body angle, eyes looking slightly off-camera, centered composition, professional personal-brand photography.
Photography Style: LinkedIn Top Voice profile photo, premium creative director portrait, founder branding shoot, luxury editorial photography, Apple-style advertising aesthetic, ultra-photorealistic, 85mm lens, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, HDR, realistic skin pores, natural hair texture, commercial studio photography, 8K.
Important: Keep the uploaded person's face 100% recognizable. Do not alter facial structure, age, hairstyle, beard, skin tone, or identity. Avoid AI-generated skin, beauty filters, plastic textures, exaggerated smiles, extra fingers, distorted hands, warped tablet, or unrealistic glasses. The final result should look indistinguishable from a real photograph taken by a top-tier branding photographer.


Prompt 5:
Create a hyper-realistic lifestyle portrait using the uploaded person's face and identity. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, facial structure, and identity with maximum accuracy.
The subject is sitting comfortably in a premium leather lounge chair inside a modern luxury apartment or high-end office. One leg is crossed casually over the other, hands resting naturally, creating a relaxed yet confident founder/CEO presence. The subject is looking directly at the camera with a subtle confident smile and calm eye contact.
Wearing a fitted premium black crew-neck t-shirt, charcoal grey tailored trousers, minimalist round metal-frame eyeglasses, and clean white sneakers. The styling should feel effortless, modern, and expensive without looking overly formal.
The environment features warm ambient interior lighting with a large designer floor lamp glowing softly in the background. Elegant wooden wall panels, luxury furniture, and tasteful decorative elements create a sophisticated executive atmosphere. Background elements remain softly blurred for depth.
Cinematic warm color grading with rich amber and golden tones. Professional key light illuminating the face naturally while practical lights in the background create beautiful bokeh. Soft shadows, realistic skin texture, natural reflections on glasses, and subtle depth separation.
Composition: Seated portrait, medium-full body framing, eye-level camera angle, centered composition, shallow depth of field, luxury lifestyle photography.
Photography Style: Netflix documentary aesthetic, entrepreneur branding photoshoot, premium personal brand photography, luxury editorial portrait, ultra-photorealistic, DSLR quality, 85mm lens, f/1.8, HDR, realistic skin pores, natural hair detail, cinematic storytelling, 8K.
Important: Keep the uploaded person's face 100% recognizable. Do not beautify, alter facial structure, change age, modify skin tone, or create an AI-generated look. The final image should feel like a real professional photoshoot of a successful founder in a premium modern workspace, captured by an elite commercial photographer.
instructions: Open your preferred image model (Google Gemini, Nano Banana, Midjourney v6.1, or Flux).
Choose from Prompts 1 through 5 based on your desired branding style (Color-Blocked Studio, Cyber Neon, Executive Founder, Creator/Designer, or Luxury Office Lifestyle).
Upload a clear reference photo of your face or anchor the prompt using the "uploaded person's face and identity" instruction.
Copy the full prompt block including Negative Prompt and realism parameters.
Generate in 4:5 or 1:1 aspect ratio for optimal LinkedIn profile picture and personal branding display.
